name: Sliding Columns
description: A wall of images in columns that slide at different rates as you scroll, leaning slightly while the scroll is fast.

props.name: images
props.description: Image sources, dealt into the columns in turn.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns. The outer columns run fast and the ones inside them lag.

props.name: strength
props.description: How far, in pixels, a column travels against its neighbours over the whole scroll.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scroll area, as any CSS length.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the scroll area, which can be focused and scrolled with the keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the scroll area.
